allowed_scope: After main test only: one unscored SNOPT Solve from exact original saved path/profile, then direct evaluator/pair queries at an intercepted q
wrapper: PyFunctionConstraint directly returns the original MinimumDistanceLowerBoundConstraint.Eval(x); exceptions capture x and input AutoDiff derivatives then rethrow.
limits: Prepared by source and installed .pyi inspection, not runtime tested.
Python forwarding preserves numeric evaluator return objects but adds callback overhead; diagnostic elapsed time is not a score.
No original trigger q was saved; same original case may not reproduce the historical exception.
A completed-main-run receipt lifecycle gate prevents intended use while registered jobs are pending. It is not numerical certification or OS-wide scheduler locking.
If no native evaluator exception occurs, no q is inferred from a last context or rounded log.
Box pair probes at an exact captured q may identify the failing pair, but native exception does not provide pair identity; this is reported as available evidence, not guaranteed capture.
Original frontend is reused as saved; no new DRM, EI-ZO, geometry, finite difference, retry, or fallback solver.
The script must be invoked only after all main and any other timed jobs have stopped.
